name: Iridescent Foil
description: A raw-WebGL thin-film iridescence surface: holographic foil and oil-on-water sheen tuned to a coastal Sand & Surf palette, whose hue band visibly travels as the pointer moves.
usage: Add a <canvas>, then call initIridescentFoil(canvas, opts) to paint a full-bleed holographic foil background that reacts to the pointer.
